string.text: %c[255,128,255,128,128] Rare, unique artifact, increases resistance to thermal structure anomalies, promotes wound healing, radioactive, full properties not yet studied. Born in thermal anomalies.
%c[255,128,255,128]A rare artefact. Increases body tone, but is radioactive

%c[255,128,255,255,128] Rare, unique and very valuable artifact, increases resistance to chemical anomalies, and removes radioactive isotopes from the body. It is born in chemical structure anomalies.

%c[255,128,255,255,128]Externally, the artifact resembles a "Kolobok"; it is widely believed to be a Kolobok crossed with a flash. Capable of dramatically increasing the wearer's muscle tone. Radioactive.

string_table.string: . "Crystal Flash"

string.text: %c[255,128,255,128]It is a reddish formation of compacted and fossilized plant, soil, and animal remains. Has the ability to partially neutralize chemicals harmful to humans. Radioactive.

%c[255,128,255,255,128]Much about this artifact remains a mystery. However, it has been reliably established that the radiation generated by the pulsation of the Crystal Beads' thickenings causes blood in open wounds to clot very quickly. Radioactive.

string_table.string: . "Crystal Beads"

string.text: %c[255,128,255,255,128]A bizarrely shaped artifact that occurs in areas of increased gravitational activity. It is a kind of sponge that absorbs radioactive elements. It successfully protects its bearer from both induced radiation and radioactive particles that have already entered the body.

%c[255,128,255,255,128]Artifact is formed by prolonged gravitational effects on metal-containing substances. Capable of maintaining a small anti-gravity field around itself. Many stalkers use it to significantly reduce the weight of their backpack. Radioactive.

string_table.string: . "Crystal Gravi"

. %c[255,128,255,255,128]The artifact is a stone close to granite. Occurs within gravitational fields of immense intensity. It can fully or partially protect the owner's mind from psi effects. Radioactive.

string.text: %c[255,128,255,128]Малоизученный артефакт. Significantly increases stamina by utilizing the body's internal reserves, but is not in demand due to significant radioactivity.
%c[255,128,255,128]Born in chemical anomalies, it has been observed to increase the body's immunity and protect against toxic effects, but is radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,128]A new artefact. Increases immunity to fire. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,128]A new artefact. Found in thermal structure anomalies. It has been noted to increase immunity to fire and accelerate wound healing. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,128]A new artefact. Most often formed in gravity anomalies. Noted to make it easier to carry weight. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,128]A new artefact. Its properties have not been fully studied yet, it is in demand among Stalkers for its ability to significantly increase the weight carried. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,255,128]Artifact of gravitational structure, quite rare, when worn on a belt increases the weight carried. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,128]A new artefact. It is shaped like a black-colored heart, which is why it was named after it. Increases the body's resistance to psi. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,128]A rare artefact. Properties have not been studied. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,255,128]An artifact of electrical structure. Creates a field around itself that can dissipate electricity. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,128]Generator is a lump of matter that resembles the shape of circles. It helps to increase the body's tone. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,255,128]A fairly rare artifact. Its properties are not fully understood, but it has been noted that it promotes wound healing and partially removes radiation.
%c[255,128,255,128]All properties are unstudied. It is known to accelerate the healing process of wounds, and protects against the effects of toxins on the body. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,255,128]A rather rare artifact, accelerates wound healing. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,255,128]A very rare artifact. Significantly increases immunity to electrical damage. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,255,128]Possibly exists in a single copy, second name Heart of the Monolith. Gives immunity to almost all negative effects of the zone.
%c[255,128,255,255,128]A very rare artifact. It was believed that it was bred by scientists in some of the laboratories by crossing several artifacts. But the rumors have never been confirmed.
%c[255,128,255,255,128]A very rare artifact. Increases overall tone, and cleanses the body of radiation...
%c[255,128,255,255,128]Possibly exists in a single copy. Rumored to have been bred by scientists in some laboratory by crossing artifacts "Clear Sky" and "Plasma".
%c[255,128,255,128]Rare artifact.It has the property of quenching psi radiation and drains toxins from the body, but due to high radioactivity is not in demand.
%c[255,128,255,128]A rare artefact. Properties are poorly understood. Noted to partially remove radionuclides from the body.
%c[255,128,255,128]A rare artefact. Properties are virtually unstudied. Radioactive
%c[255,128,255,128]A rare artefact. Increases immunity to fire, and detoxifies the body. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,255,128]Born only in the Klaksa anomaly, for which it got its name. Properties are not studied. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,128]A rare artefact. Restores strength and gives significant immunity to psi effects, but is radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,128]This very rare artifact looks like an eye, which is why it was named. When injured, it speeds up metabolic processes, which promotes rapid healing of wounds. Radioactive.

%c[255,128,255,128]This very rare artifact looks and feels like an exact copy of the brain, for which it is named. In case of injuries, it speeds up metabolic processes, which helps wounds to heal faster. It also weakens the effects of radiation.
%c[255,128,255,128]A rare artefact. Properties are unstudied. Can form in absolutely any anomaly. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,128]A rare artefact. Full properties have not been studied. Formed in gravitational anomalies. Known to help resist psi effects.
%c[255,128,255,128]A rare artefact. Properties not studied. Formed in elemental anomalies. Radioactive.
%c[255,128,255,255,128] Unstudied, radioactive formation, born in chemical structure anomalies.

%c[255,128,255,255,128] A very rare artifact, so many wanderers attribute its existence to baes. Has slight radiation, but increases resistance to chemical structure anomalies. In addition, if placed in a backpack, it significantly lightens the weight of the contents, almost doubling the weight.

%c[255,128,255,255,128] A rare, unique artifact. Has slight radiation, increases resistance to chemical structure anomalies. Full properties have not yet been studied, but it is said that the artifact promotes wound healing.
%c[255,128,255,255,128] A rare, unique artifact. Has a small radiation, increases resistance to thermal and electrical anomalies. Born in anomalous zones combining electra and fry.
%c[255,128,255,255,128] Rare, unique artifact, properties poorly understood. Most often born in chemical anomalies, rumored to be in demand in the greater earth for its ability to jam radio signals.

%c[255,128,255,255,128] Unique artifact. Was found in a single instance on the rifts of Zaton. To this day, scientists have not come to a definite conclusion that the artifact is primary, the artifact is formed on the site of a fault in the Earth's crust, or the artifact itself generates these faults. Increases resistance to all types of anomalies. Radioactive.

A formation of thermal nature. The Itcher consists of two separated layers. The surface is a hard, dense metamorphic rock with deep scars covering the entire body. Completely inactive and doesn't hold any noticeable properties. On the other hand, the soft, yellow glowing core is from unknown organic nature. It actively consumes excessive heat and remains cool at all times. 
However, it is not recommended to approach chemical and acid anomalies when in possession of the artefact as it will increase the adverse effects of acids and toxins in user's bloodstream. 
 
Radiation output is low on the artefact radiation scale.

A small artefact formed by thermal anomalies in the Zone under extreme temperatures. The look of this artefact suggests that it was an organ of a vascular plant. Further studies showed that other organic tissues are fused deep inside. 
The stem doesn't hold any useful properties. On the contrary, the small pins reduce temperature of user's body and cool all objects in their vicinity. 
This artefact offers a slight psy-protection as it will resonate under the influence of psy-waves. On the other hand, it is not recommended to approach chemical and acid anomalies when in possession of the artefact as it will increase the adverse effects of acids and toxins in user's bloodstream. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

This artefact is formed in anomalous zones with intense thermal activity. Actively consumes excessive heat and remains cool at all times. 
It will also protect the user against electrical currents. On the other hand, exposure to such environments makes the artefact increase the conductivity due to unknown as of now mechanism. For this reason, one is forced to weigh pros and cons of Crystal when in the vicinity of areas of high conductivity. 
This artefact is also highly sought for by jewellers outside the Zone as its inner core is not radioactive and considered to be of exceptional beauty if polished and refined. Only the first 1 cm of its outer layer emits radiation. 
It is, however, highly advised to proceed with caution when planning to bring the artefact to the market as prolonged exposure to even minimal amounts of radioactive materials can result in death of the user. Covered with very hard layer. Relatively heavy due to high density. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

It is a spherical artefact made of red-coloured crystal, created in the Burner anomaly. 
It has an unique property: it has a constant temperature of 75 degrees Fahrenheit/24 degrees Celsius, regardless of its surroundings. This allows it to absorb heat from its vicinity and to create a little pocket around the user which prevents the flames from damaging the body. 
A dangerous effect of this artefact is the fact that it will increase electrical conductivity, so the probability of electrocution while wearing this artefact is much higher, especially during storms and in the vicinity of electrical anomalies.It is quite heavy due to high density of crystal-like material. 
 
Radiation output is high on the artefact radiation scale.

A reddish formation of compressed fossilised plants, soil and animal debris. Can partially neutralise chemical poisons by absorbing them and reducing overall toxicity level in user's bloodstream. Quite widespread and not very effective as it makes chemical burns fester. It will catch fire when exposed to open flame or even spontaneously combust. 
Another positive effect possessed by this artefact is that it accelerates clotting if worn close to the body. Although it is not recommended to keep this artefact in your possession for longer periods of time as blood clots can be hazardous to your health. 
 
Radiation output is low on the artefact radiation scale.

This artefact has soft, porous, skin-like texture and is said to be able to compress. It resembles and acts like a sponge in this regard, but reveals its special characteristics only when exposed to certain external conditions. 
Firstly, to carry the sponge metaphor further, the pores on its surface are known to absorb small amounts of toxicity from environment. 
Secondly, the artefact slightly amplifies the damaging effects of psy-fields to living organisms by absorbing psy energy and emitting it at a small rate. 
Thirdly, Meat Chunk is also known to be a conductor of electricity much like the skin of a living creature. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

Bracelet is formed from common species of bryophytes plants under high exposure to radioactive and chemical anomalies, which explains its organic nature. 
It provides substantial protection against all types of acids by gradually increasing their pH to the level of water (pH of 7). 
When worn, the artefact is also known to slightly counter the harmful effects of psy-anomalies or psy-waves of some mutants. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

A compound of several hollow organic formations, this artefact emits a gaseous substance that can neutralise chemical or toxic particles inside the body without harming it. Thus providing a a great level of toxic and chemical protection. 
It also has a constant temperature regardless of its surroundings. This allows it to absorb heat from its vicinity and to create a little pocket around the user which prevents the flames from damaging the body. 
Apart from that Bubble, however, possesses numerous negative properties. For example, it greatly amplifies the effects of psy-waves as well as fields produced by mutants and anomalies. This disadvantage is not to be taken lightly: some stalkers have reported that psy influence was so potent when in possession of a Bubble that they felt their heads cracking from the inside and the only thing they could do was scream in pain and run as far as they could. 
 
Radiation output is high on the artefact radiation scale.

This artefact has the appearance of translucent spider webs. Just as proteinaceous spider silk, it is sticky and has properties of glue. 
It can be found most commonly in or near electro anomalies and it seems to have absorbed their certain characteristics: it is able to smooth fluctuations in electric field density and acts as a weak resistor, protecting the wearer from electricity and reducing its damaging effects. 
On the other hand, it should be noted that the presence of this artefact increases the corrosiveness of acids, leading to accelerated deterioration of equipment and higher damage to tissues of any living organism. 
 
Radiation output is low on the artefact radiation scale.

Sponge has always been under debate among the Ecologists. Some suggest that this artefact is driven from basic form of organisms, while others believe its an advanced life form with self-awareness inherited from living creatures. 
Despite the theories surrounding the artefact, all can agree on one thing: it moves. The sponge sometimes tries to "grab" an object it touches. Putting it in a container might be a hard task, as if it wants to escape. 
This artefact acts as a powerful resistor and will absorb even lethal doses of electricity. On the other hand, it will catch fire when exposed to open flame or even spontaneously combust. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

A very small artefact of electric nature. Difficult to spot. Consists of two ring-shaped materials of organic nature, hence the given name. When the Ring spins, it never stops spinning, defying the first law of thermodynamics. Scientists suggest that this artefact inherits gravitational properties from Vortex anomalies. 
The outer ring has a high-conductivity. It absorbs electrical current from relative sources then ground it in the inner ring. Despite the basic function, the mechanism behind the disappearance of electrical power inside the second ring is still unknown. 
On the other side, the Ring is flammable. Prolonged exposure may enhance its flammability and cause it to ignite. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

This artefact is very similar in appearance to Moonlight and resembles a plasma globe or a plasma lamp. 
Being a powerful resistor, it is well known for its ability to shield its user from lethal doses of electricity. 
When worn, it is known to slightly counter harmful effects of psy-anomalies or psy-waves of certain mutants. Flash acts as a powerful resistor and will absorb even lethal doses of electricity. 
However, it also hinders healing process, thus caution is advised especially when wounded or bleeding. This artefact is also extremely light and very portable. 
 
Radiation output is high on the artefact radiation scale.

This artefact resembles melted cheese interspersed with sapphire-like stones. Only yellow outer shell of the artefact appears to give off radiation and by careful processing it is possible to extract the non-radioactive blue parts for jewellery and other industrial purposes. This is due to the fact that if cleaned properly and polished, sapphire comparison becomes much more explicit: the stones are as hard and durable as this beautiful gem. This quality of theirs and their appearance make them perfect gemstones and jewellers all over the world strive to have them in stock. 
The usefulness of the artefact, however, is not limited to its industrial applications. There is scientific evidence suggesting that sapphire-like stones effectively protect from psy-waves, whereas the outer shell slightly increases resistance to toxicity. 
However, it can cause objects in its vicinity to heat up and in extreme cases to ignite along with the artefact. For this reason, it is safe to conclude that it absorbs heat and is able to convey it to other objects. 
Due to its density the weight of artefact has increased beyond normal standards, and thus it is one of the heaviest anomalous creations in the Zone. 
 
Radiation output is low on the artefact radiation scale.

As the name suggests, this artefact has the shape of two eggs fused together. The outer surface is very thick, the high density of its formation might be the reason behind its deep colour. 
This artefact offers slightly more psy-protection than its cousin, Stone Flower. It resonates under the influence of psy-waves to some degree and absorbs the dangerous effect. 
Another positive property is the ability to consume excessive heat while remaining cool at all times. 
Due to its density of the surface, the Lobster Eyes is quite heavy. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

This unique electrostatic artefact can resonate under the influence of psy-waves. Stalkers have learned to fine-tune the artefact so that it resonates in opposite phase to the main source of emissions, thus significantly neutralizing their effects. This orb of considerable beauty also increases electrical protection by reducing conductivity in the body when exposed to high levels of electricity. 
It should be noted that Moonlight will catch fire when exposed to open flame or even spontaneously combust. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

Being a rare artefact, little is known about its properties and origins. 
Black Spray shares a similar shape to other sapphire-like artefacts. However, the organic nature of the stem (which shares similar properties to Pin artefacts) suggests that its formed from vascular plants under exposure to dangerous psy-fields and electromagnetic waves. 
Another unique property is the ability to delay the transmission of light that enters it. The said mysterious mechanism is applied to psy-waves surrounding the artefact as well. For this particular reason, Black Spray significantly neutralises psy interferences in a large radius. 
These beneficial properties, however, come at a price. This artefact is extremely dangerous when exposed in toxic environments as it amplifies their effect and increases their potency. When exploring toxic areas, it is hence highly recommended to keep the artefact in your backpack. 
Due to the beautiful blue aura it emits, it is highly sought after by jewellers all over the world. 
 
Radiation output is high on the artefact radiation scale.

Very common in the Zone. This gravitational artefact is able to slightly shield the body and objects from physical impacts. 
It will slightly protect its user against extreme heat produced respectively by fire anomalies. 
This artefact is quite heavy as the gravitational field seems to increase mass. Another downside to this artefact is that it will increase the negative effects of psy-waves and is a potent conductor. 
 
Radiation output is low on the artefact radiation scale.

This bizarrely-shaped artefact appears in places with increased gravitational activity. 
Although it appears almost organic, it is actually more similar to coral. Due to its gravitational nature, It provides protection against physical impacts as it greatly reduces the friction caused by fast objects. 
Acting as a kind of sponge that absorbs chemical and toxic elements as well, this artefact provides protection from external toxic agents as well as from chemical particles that have already made their way into the body. 
Wrenced can generate a locally directed gravity field which increases its mass. For this reason, this artefact is heavy. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

Two disks of organic formation (commonly lipids, cellulose and lignin) with nothing but empty space in between. This is due to a unique gravitation field formed in the centre that stabilise the distance between the disks. 
Any attempt to press the disks together, or pull them apart will fail due to rapid positive/negative changes in the gravitational field. As if the artefact reacts to any physical power that breaks its balance. 
Because of this mechanism, moving with an Empty is a hard task. As the gravitational field increases the density of surrounding air and slows the body down. 
The real usefulness of this effect comes to the ability to reduce friction, thus obtaining great protection against physical impacts. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

Similar to Empty, this artefact consist of two disks of organic formation connected by a unique gravitational field in between. However, the said field in Full Empty is extraordinary: all atoms entering the centre, regardless of their nature, become interactive under the unknown effects of the field. Thus releasing photons (light emitting). 
Scientists usually refer to it as the "galaxy effect", which gives the artefact an exceptional orbit of light. 
The density increment of surrounding air caused by moving is higher comparing to Empty. Because of this, the artefact will greatly hinder its holder's movement. 
Being superior artefact to Empty, the protection against physical impacts is remarkable. Some claims that Full Empty is capable of stopping 9mm bullets fired at point blank. 
 
Radiation output is high on the artefact radiation scale.

This glowing artefact can generate a local directed low-gravity field. Widely used by stalkers along with Gravi, a similar artefact, to increase maximum load. 
Due to its beautiful inner core it is highly sought after by jewellers all over the world, however it is best to proceed with caution as unskilled treatment can cause the artefact to explode with power sufficient to level a small building. It is thus highly advised to perform the polishing by means of specialised machinery, which minimises the probability of explosion. Moreover, only the outer core of the artefact emits radiation. 
Nightstar will also absorb toxic and chemical agents from the environment, which makes it a valuable artefact for artefact hunters, although the amount of toxicity absorbed is negligible. It is, however, relatively cheap and even stalkers with pretty tight budgets can afford it if opportunity to buy it arises. 
That being said, Nightstar emits odour of burning flesh when in the closest proximity of heat source. Prolonged exposure may enhance its flammability and cause it to ignite. 
 
Radiation output is low on the artefact radiation scale.

Gravi is formed from metallic substances exposed to prolonged gravitation. This makes it capable of sustaining an powerful anti-gravitational field, which causes it to have various properties, among others reducing weight of all objects in its close proximity. For a long time, the artefact was a mystery, and it was scientist Sakharov at Yantar who first discovered that Gravi creates a minute singularity field of anti-gravitational nature, the phenomenon which occurs in intervals of 30 minutes. 
A dangerous effect of this artefact is the fact that it will increase electrical conductivity, so the probability of electrocution while wearing this artefact is much higher, especially during storms and in the vicinity of electrical anomalies. 
Another downside is that it will increase the negative effects of psy-waves and is a potent conductor. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

Direct successor to and a superior version of Gravi artefact. As was the case with Gravi, it was scientist Sakharov at Yantar who discovered its unique properties after a massive blowout/emission hit the Zone. 
Thanks to meticulous research that followed, it was established that this new artefact is produced when three Gravi artefacts interact and get sucked into one another's singularity fields. This phenomenon is extremely rare, due to which the artefact is highly valued. 
It is rumoured within Ukrainian Spetsnaz circles that in the Zone there are agents from the Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation whose sole objective is acquiring and transporting Goldfish to specialised laboratories located outside of the Zone. 
The artefact creates a constant anti-gravitational singularity field which affects only its closest vicinity. However, some stalkers have been known to disappear for no apparent reason leaving only a Goldfish behind. 
Big downside, however, comes along with this powerful anti-gravitational field: the velocity of moving objects inside its radius will rapidly increase, causing dangerous impacts on surrounding objects, including the holder. 
 
Radiation output is highest on the artefact radiation scale.

Shaped like a DNA helix, Mama's Beads are created in the Burner anomaly. One of their most characteristic features is that they constantly pulsate, generating emissions beneficial to the human body. These emissions increase the metabolism of any living creature, accelerating coagulation and healing of wounds.The mechanism behind the effects of this artefact is still unknown. 
Mama's Beads also possess potent protective qualities: they are able to shield the body and objects from extreme heat. 
On the other hand, it should be noted that the presence of this artefact increases electrical conductivity, so the probability of electrocution while wearing this artefact is much higher, especially during storms and in the vicinity of electrical anomalies. 
The weight is also quite high for such a small artefact, which leads to a conclusion that is of high density. 
 
Radiation output is low on the artefact radiation scale.

This artefact, which resembles the human eye, considerably increases metabolism of the body, helping wounds heal quicker. Experienced stalkers say that Eye also brings luck. Irrespective of the validity of that statement, its positive effects are indeed quite potent. 
This artefact soothes the pain and is extremely useful when treating wounds. 
When worn, it is known to slightly counter harmful effects of psy-anomalies or psy-waves of certain mutants. 
These beneficial qualities, however, come at a price. This artefact is extremely dangerous when exposed to chemical anomalies as it amplifies their toxicity and increases their potency. It is hence highly recommended to keep the artefact in your backpack, never on the body, when exploring toxic areas unless you have a death wish. 
The artefact is also known colloquially as "copper eye" as it conducts electricity and amplifies its dangerous effects in the same way as copper does. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

This artefact forms in areas of high thermal activity. Produces powerful infrared emissions which intensify metabolic processes, healing wounds before its bearer's very eyes. 
Its healing capabilities are even stronger than in case of the Eye as stalkers in possession of this artefact are said to have survived being wounded by chimeras. Thanks to that, it has earned the reputation of a miraculous artefact. 
Many stalkers owe it their lives, and most veteran mutant hunters carry it in case they run into danger. However, it shares not only positive but also negative properties of its cousin: entering a psy-field with this artefact on the belt is suicide. It will absorb psy energy and emitting it at a considerable rate. 
Also, it is highly advised to proceed with caution when planning to bring the artefact to the market as prolonged exposure to even minimal amounts of radioactive materials can result in death of the user. 
It can also be used as a reusable medkit of sorts since it heals wounds very quickly. 
 
Radiation output is high on the artefact radiation scale.

The artefact is quite popular in the Zone and is valued by its residents and visitors alike for its energizing properties, although it has an adverse effect on the body when used for prolonged periods of time. 
One should take note, however, that this artefact hinders blood clotting and increases bleeding rate of open wounds. On the other hand, being a powerful resistor, it is well known for its ability to shield its user from lethal doses of electricity. 
Being an artefact of electric nature, it is well known for its ability to shield its user from lethal doses of electricity. On the contrary, it should be noted that Battery absorbs heat and is able to convey it to other objects. 
This artefact is also extremely light and very portable. 
 
Radiation output is low on the artefact radiation scale.

Shell is composed of two disk of bluish colour connected by semitransparent material of unknown nature. 
This strange artefact was considered devoid of any useful properties by many scientists for a long time. Only recently has it been discovered that it is indeed quite beneficial. 
When the artefact comes into contact with the body, it will make one feel rejuvenated and thus it increases stamina recovery. This effect has in case of some stalkers induced hyperactivity. One downside of this artefact, however, is that it reduces the number of platelets in blood, thus increasing bleeding rate. 
It provides a considerable level of psy protection and absorbs electromagnetic interference, acting as a grounding material. 
It will catch fire when exposed to open flame or even spontaneously combust. Caution must be taken when approaching heat sources with this artefact. 
Shell is extremely light and very portable. 
 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

Also colloquially known as "Radioactive Snowflake". At first glance, this artefact resembles a white Kolobok. 
Thanks to its unique properties, the artefact can significantly increase the bearer's muscle tone, thus greatly improving stamina recovery. Due to its high radioactivity, stalkers in possession of it are sometimes jokingly referred to as "Radioactive Snowflakes". 
When faced with the decision whether to carry it on the belt during a mission, you have to carefully weigh its pros and cons: does it pay to have greater endurance and high protection against electricity at the cost of being constantly exposed to its deadly radiation? Even if you are determined to take it with you, it should be noted that it is not to be used on long excursions to the Zone. 
Snowflake, however, holds a big downside: it interacts with surrounding energy sources by absorbing and amplifying their effects. For this reason, approaching heat sources, toxic areas and psy-fields while holding this artefact is a suicide. 
It is as light as a snowflake and very easy to carry around. 
 
Radiation output is high on the artefact radiation scale.

Soul is a unique organic artefact with properties just as unique: it secretes slimy goo that dramatically increases recovery rate of wounds. Thanks to its reasonable price and attractive appearance, this artefact is a valuable collector's item. 
Applying its gooey substance to wounds will soothes the pain and speeds up healing process. \It also reduces the effects of psy-waves and their damage to one's brain. But it should be known that Soul drains power from its user. The artefact does not have high density and thus is not very heavy. 
 
Radiation output is low on the artefact radiation scale.

A relatively rare artefact forming in chemical areas, Kolobok is highly valued for its ability to heal most kinds of wounds and stop bleeding in a matter of minutes. 
For unknown reasons, scientists are spreading rumours among stalkers that the artefact modifies bearer's genetic code, which is unproven and should be regarded as conscious attempt at monopolizing the supply of the artefact by the scientific community. This does not, however, mean that it is completely harmless. 
One drawback of this artefact is the fact that it will interact to radioactive particles, so it is best to avoid radiation fields when in possession of the artefact, especially since its negative effects are not balanced with positive ones. It will also reduce energy recovery, which is the result of its sharp needle-like appendages. The needles cause small and quickly healing wounds which bring constant pain and itch, thus reducing stamina. 
This artefact also weakens protection against heat and acids due to its high flammability. 
Lightweight and not too much of a burden to carry around. 
Radiation output is average on the artefact radiation scale.

Firefly interacts with fields unknown to science, considerably speeding up regeneration of tissue and organs in living beings, as well as normalizing metabolic processes. 
This artefact can literally get a badly wounded stalker back on his feet in a matter of minutes. On the other hand, Firefly can spontaneously combust when exposed to potent radioactive sources. 
A big downside to this artefact is that it weakens the body and reduce the number of platelets in blood during heal process, thus increasing bleeding rate. 
It seems to drain stamina and decrease stamina recovery greatly as well. Some of those who used Firefly for its healing purposes have reported that they couldn't walk for hours afterwards. 
Unfortunately, Firefly is extremely rare. 
Radiation output is high on the artefact radiation scale.

A very rare artefact. It's been several years since one was found. 
It can locate gaps in anomaly fields. It is believed that it can help one traverse the most complex anomaly fields completely unharmed. However, very few know how to handle it properly. 
The Compass showed few unique properties under last experiments. It can interact to moving objects, causing some to completely disappear. Or perhaps teleport? 
It also weakens the body by draining stamina and increasing bleeding rate constantly. But the biggest draw however, is the dangerous radiation output this artefact emits comparing to the artefact radiation scale. 
Holding this artefact near the body will cause death in matter of few minutes.

This artefact was found at the centre of the legendary Oasis. It appears that the Heart is a crystallised plant, which has acquired the healing properties of the Oasis. 
Not only it dramatically increases recovery rate of wounds and healing process, but also provides the body with strong source of energy. It is a true miracle. 
That being said, the Oasis is very sensitive to outer sources of energy and surrounding environment. For this reason, interacting with anomaly fields will bring death to the holder. 
 
Radiation output is highest on the artefact radiation scale.

"Big, red and cursed." 
This is how the locals prefer to describe the Death Lamp, while some refer to it as the "Seed of Satan". Many traders believe the rumours surrounding the artefact, thus refusing to buy it. Little is known about its origins, and nothing of value has been discovered so far. 
Death Lamp was first discovered few years ago by a group of three experienced stalkers. Shortly after delivering the artefact to the Ecologists in Yantar, two of them found dead with a horrific expression on their faces. Nothing is known about the fate of the third stalker. 
Following the accident, members of the science team who studied the artefact had reported having nightmare disorder in the days to follow. 
Apart from the mysterious effects, the artefact drains vitality and willpower from the user, often on such a scale that it induces dizziness and in extreme cases causes the user to faint. 
 
Radiation output is highest on the artefact radiation scale.

The origins of artefacts such as this one are a mystery, as they are rarely found outside the northernmost parts of the Zone. \nThis unique artefact projects a non-contact field that inhibits nearbly anomalous phenomena. This grants the wearer a notable level of protection against most of the Zone's environmental hazards. It is also one of the few active artefacts that can be safely handled without lead containers. However, when you hold it your flesh feels dry and flaky, your bones hard and stiff, the ligaments in your joints squeaky and brittle. Thick armour or great supernatural vitality would be needed by anyone intending to wear this artefact into battle.
Truly, an amazing thing. The Black Stone protects against broadly considered adversity but instead is slowly killing the owner. Some stalkers suspect the artefact is a shard of the Monolith.

A piece of bread as dark as the soul of the person that left it.
 
%c[ui_gray_2]PROPERTIES:
%c[ui_white] • %c[ui_gray_2] artefact
%c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] attachable
Formed in the Burner anomaly, at high temperatures. From the exterior, it looks like a tear-like shade compound with a glossy surface, covered in cracks.

It is certain that this artefact is created by the anomaly called 'Fruit punch'. When carried on the belt the wounds bleed less, although the body of its owner becomes more vulnerable to various burns.

Formed by the 'Fruit punch' anomaly. The negative qualities of this artefact are compensated by the fact that it heightens the coagulation quality of blood. It's not often that one runs into such an artefact, and they pay well for it too.
Anomaly 'Fruit punch' is able to create such an artefact at the rarest, most extreme collection of physical conditions. The result is a semi-transparent, hard object. A rare and expensive artefact.
According to the opinion of some researchers-theorists, this artefact is a hybrid between Batteries and Shell.
This artefact is so rare that many researchers can't even imagine that such a substance can exist in a natural setting. Emits acidic chemical components.

The result of the interaction between the anomaly Burnt Fuzz and the body of a careless stalker. The Thorn artefact pokes the body of its owner, no matter what. But it also helps clean the body of radionuclide. Quite widespread and cheap.

Crystallizes in the anomaly Burnt Fuzz. Naturally takes out the radiation from the organism. That is, through the ears along with some amount of blood. Blood loss is possible also through over openings. Widespread and quite effective, which is the cause for the stable price in the artefact market.

The anomaly Burnt Fuzz very rarely gives rise to this artefact. Raise the blood pressure and so, the body gets rid of a large amount of red blood cells. But along with them the stored radiation leaves the body as well. In his fundamental work titled 'Ionization and polarization of the components of rare artefacts', Sakharov noted that the content of this formation has a critical stability, and it's not realistic to create such an artefact in lab conditions in the next ten years.
This Сompass found even less often than the ordinary one. There are no negative effects on the body.
Apparently, it is a crystallized plant, has beneficial effect on the body as a whole. No negative properties.
Rare artefact. Protects from psi fields and slightly from electricity. It also has a field that lightens objects around it a little. No negative properties.
Very rare artefact of fiery kind. Somewhat resembles a snake, hence got its name. Helps with healing wounds.

Very rare artefact of plant origin. It is valued by stalkers for the help in removing radiation and healing wounds. It also slightly protects against psi fields and absorbs excessive heat. Has no negative properties.
It is a rather ugly reddish formation of compressed and fancy curved polymerized plants residue, soil and bones. Slightly increases carry weight. Has no negative properties.
The artefact spawns in anomalous zones under high temperatures conditions. Slowly removes radiation from the body. No negative properties.

The artefact is basically a stone which has characteristics close to granites. It comes into being inside gravitational fields of huge intensity. Lowers weight of carried things and slightly protects against the effects of psi fields. Radioactive.
Previously considered trash deprived of any beneficial properties. However, some time ago it turned out that when in constant contact with the human body, this artefact slightly enhances muscle tone.
Much in this artefact remains a mystery. However, it was well established that radiation, arising with the pulsation of Beads thickenings, stops blood. Radioactive.
This artefact of electrostatic nature demonstrates the ability to remove radiation from the body, also slightly improves muscle tone. Has no negative properties.
A representative of the family of electrostatic artefacts, got its name for its brightness. Has the ability to perfectly smooth out electric field voltage drops. Radioactive.
Common representative of the family of electrostatic artefacts. Slowly removes radiation. No negative properties.

Despite the name, which fully reflects the nature of this artefact, the orb can be easily kept in hand without fear of getting burned. Makes blood stop a little faster and possible to sit closer to the fire. Radioactive.
When holding this mystery of the Zone in hands, can feel how body becomes lighter. Allows to carry much more goods, but the price for it is bleeding from punctures.
Very rare artefact, which allows to take a lot of additional useful in raids equipment, but with such an artefact it is better not to get into anomalies.
Average priced artefact. It well enough removes radiation and slightly lightens a backpack. Has no negative properties.
This artefact is good for long-term raids. Will less often want to eat or take a rest, but it is better not to come across controller. A little radioactive.
Rare, beautiful artefact, which provides high protection from different psi effects. Radioactive.
Organic artefact with unique properties. Increases carrying capacity in uknown way, and with it you can forget what food is. Has no negative properties.
The average prevalence artefact, which lightens carried weight and protects against psi fields. Radioactive.
Extraordinary artefact. Probably no one knows its origin. Heal wounds, restores strength and slightly removes radiation, but hunger comes a little faster with it.

This artefact is strangely similar to Water Flower artefact. Among positive properties, should be noted bleeding stoppage, reduced backpack weight and slow radiation removal, but negatively affects digestion.
Reminds a baby rattle with spines, from where went the name of it... Helps the body to faster restore strength, gives protection against chemical and electrical anomalies. A little radioactive.
Rather common artefact of electrical nature. Helps the organism to quicker restore energy. Radioactive.
Extremely rare artefact resembling a pulsating heart. It has a positive effect on the whole body, but a large minus is the strongest amplification of psi waves affecting the owner. Radioactive.

Rare artefact that looks like a caterpillar. It was first found in Wild Territory away from any anomalies, so initially it was mistaken for a new creature in the Zone, but later it started to be found in anomalies. Allows to carry more in a backpack, restores strength and slightly removes radiation, but gradually saps health of the owner. Also with this artefact it is better not to approach sources of high temperature.

Hyperabsolute, artefact, which is likely to be obtained only once, given the extreme rarity of components and other transmutation conditions. Conglomeration of huge amount of energy and vitality, multiple times reducing radiation. Possible both one-off and, probably, continuous usage of artefact's properties. The price of this hyperabsolute is purely symbolic, since only few know about the possibility of obtaining this artefact.

Absolute, obtained by transmuting the artefact Burer's Great-grandmother's Beads for 5 minutes in the Burner anomaly. The recipe was obviously obtained by conducting experiments. Among positive qualities, it is necessary to note an increased resistance of its host to bullet injuries.

Rare artefact, that looks like a real heart. First stalker who found it, almost missed it, taking it for the remains of a less successful fellow. Pretty quickly restores health and strength, but attracts electricity. A little radioactive.

It resembles the ordinary Jellyfish, but is green. Absolutely not radioactive, emits weak light. It is believed that it appears as a result of the combination of two anomalies. Gradually heals body of the owner and removes radiation, but increases effects that toxins and psi fields have on the organism.
It looks like the ordinary Subwrenched, but is green. Absolutely not radioactive, emits weak light. Gradually heals body of the owner and removes radiation quite well. Has no negative properties.
It looks like the ordinary Stone Blood, but is green. Absolutely not radioactive, emits weak light. Gradually heals body of the owner. Has no other properties.
It resembles the ordinary Pellicle, but is red. Radioactive, emits light. Provides protection against thermal effects.
It resembles ordinary Spring, but is red. Radioactive. Heals wounds and moderately protects against high temperatures.
It resembles ordinary Battery, but is red. Not radioactive. Heals scratches and removes radiation quite well.
One of the most valuable artefacts in the Zone. Removes radiation from the body of the owner in a matter of minutes and provides the biggest protection against psi waves. No negative properties.
One of the most valuable artefacts in the Zone. Quickly heals wounds of the owner and provides the biggest protection against thermal effects. No negative properties.
One of the most valuable artefacts in the Zone. Quickly restores forces of the owner and provides the biggest protection against electrical impacts. No negative properties.
One of the most valuable artefacts in the Zone. Quickly restores health of the owner and provides the biggest protection against chemicals. No negative properties.
Like the Mother's Beads, it stops bleeding, but for a lower radiation dose.
This artifact heals wounds even better, compared to Grandmother's Beads, but the radiation dose increased twice.
Its temporal field is very strong and has a large radius. Raises irradiation.
Anomalous formation from a family of double-disc artefacts. Allows to carry a little more weight in a backpack, gradually restores energy and heals scratches. Radioactive.
Anomalous formation from a family of double-disc artefacts. Allows to carry a little more weight in a backpack, gradually heals the body. Radioactive.
Anomalous formation from a family of double-disc artefacts. Restores health, heals wounds and scratches. No negative properties.
Anomalous formation from a family of double-disc artefacts. When equipped, significantly strengthens muscles of the back, which makes it possible to carry more weight in the backpack. Radioactive.
Anomalous formation from a family of barbed artefacts. Like the Battery, enhances restoration of the body forces pretty well.
Anomalous formation from a family of barbed artefacts. Just like Snowflake, significantly increases restoration of the body forces, but with a lesser radiation dose.
Anomalous formation from a family of barbed artefacts. Makes it possible to carry a little more rounds, restores health and strength. Radioactive.
Anomalous formation from a family of barbed artefacts. Restores health and forces, heals wounds. Radioactive.

This artefact is interesting primarily for a special field generated around owner, which knocks off fired at person bullets from trajectory. Far from every bullet, but still. Such feature is wonderful and absolutely unexplored by scientists. In addition, the Steel Kolobok reduces skin sensitivity to rupture. Unfortunately, radioactive.
Titanium Kolobok lowers skin sensitivity to rupture and fire, generated field knocks off some percentage of bullets aiming at it from their trajectories. Unfortunately, radioactive.
This artefact gives the owner resistance to skin rupture, reduces effects of fire and chemically aggressive environments and with its field "diverts" some of the bullets. Radioactive.
This artefact got its name due to the fact that it grants a great strength to a person, however, because of high tension the skin starts to rip and bleeding begins. Radioactive.
Artefact makes it possible to carry a little more things in a backpack. Has no other properties.
Scale in general has beneficial effect on the body. Radioactive.
Armor reduces bleeding of those who wear it. Has no other properties.
This artefact moderately protects against all anomalistic hazards of the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone, but is best against psi waves, which is why it was called so. Radioactive.

There are rumors that in order to get this artefact, you need to throw certain artefacts into a chemical anomaly. But this is refuted by stalkers who find it just like that in anomalies. Pretty beautiful, helps carry more weight in a backpack and restores health, but increases total energy consumption. Radioactive.

Iridescent apple sized sphere, which slowly rotates half a meter above the ground. It produces subtle, on the verge of audibility squeak. Increases sensitivity to thermal effects, but in return restores health, strength and heals wounds. Radioactive.
Pretty rare and expensive artefact. Great radiation remover. No negative properties.
Appearance really resembles hedgehog. Covered with many dull needles. Restores forces, health and heals wounds. No negative properties.
Rather rare. Can be found only in northern regions of the Zone. Good effect on the body as a whole. Radioactive.
A jelly-like translucent sphere covered with a wet pellicle, warm, almost hot to touch. Increases carry weight, slightly restores strength and vitalizes the blood. No negative properties.
Pretty much common artefact in the center of Zone. Has an oblongated shape of a gingery drop with green hue. Increases resistance to electricity and restores health. Radioactive.
Small, fist sized, bluish white sphere. As if made of ice with small dark blue splashes. Has beneficial effect on the body as a whole. Radioactive.
The artefact received name for an intricately elongated cylindrical form that casts a silvery color. It has a positive effect on the whole organism. Radioactive.
Another rarest of Zone's artefacts. It is a dark brown color walnut sized ball, which is why it actually got its name. Gives vigor and saturation effect to its owner. Radioactive.

Dimensions and shape remotely resemble a chicken egg, has a deep black color and glitters under the light. If split, a very strong impulse of unknown nature emerges. Increases electrical protection and carried weight. Radioactive.
It is a translucent faded orb, blue-green on the edges, size of a fist. Center has a thick matte coloring. Restores health and protects against toxins. Radioactive.

Round shimmering formation with zero gravity. Violin has an exclusively aesthetic value - the artefact floats in half a meter over any surface and brightly overflows with all rainbow colors. In addition, catched by the slightest breeze, emites melodious ringing in different tones, thereby hypnotizing the owner. Also adds weight to contents of backpack, but in return gives an inflow of strength and accelerated wounds healing. Radioactive.

Appearance resembles two mushroom heads that look absolutely the same, maybe therefore it was called so. Artefact will increase your thermal protection, and allows to carry a little more goods. Radioactive.
Artefact generated by the Gravi anomaly, appearance somewhat resembles ice cream. Increases carry weight and protects against chemical anomalies. Radioactive.
It is apparently named so because it reminds this inornate plant. Has beneficial effect on the body as a whole. Radioactive.
Somewhat resembles a spider, removes radiation better than Bubble. Has no negative properties.
Small artefact, radioactive, slightly increases carried weight and protects against psi fields.
Artefact that slightly protects the organism from toxins. Has no other properties.
The artefact quite strongly reminds of the jaw, apparently it was named so because of this. Artefact will slightly increase the carry weight, health and treat wounds. Radioactive.
Artefact looks like an integral part of the Atom. Increases carried weight, restores health and strength. Radioactive.
Anomalous formation, appearance of which resembling translucent moss. Slightly restores health, strength and heals wounds. Radioactive.
A fairly common artefact created by Electra anomaly. Helps to carry few more extra artefacts to the buyer. Radioactive.
Insufficiently explored artefact created by Electra anomaly. In general, positively affects the body of the owner. Radioactive.
Artefact resembling an atom, with a core and rotating electrons around it. Increases carry weight and moderately protects against psi fields. Radioactive.

Artefact got its name from the first stalker who found it, Sanya Philosopher. Despite the name, there is nothing unusual about it. Slightly increases carried weight, heals the owner and treats scratches. Radioactive.
Solid, transparent artefact with a luminous substance inside. Moderately protects against electrical effects and restores energy. Radioactive.

Very strange artefact, which behavior is similar to parasite. The black stone kills its owner, but in return increases power and treats open wounds, as if it does not want to share the blood of the owner.

Like the medicine of the same name, it is valued and widely used. Restores health quite well and increases protection against chemical anomalies. Despite radioactivity, many stalkers use this artefact.
Artefact looks like a cracked overgrown chestnut with sharp spikes. A pretty good artefact that helps in every aspect, but only just a little. No negative properties.
Pinky, translucent grainy palm sized ingot. Increases carry weight, restores health and heals wounds. Radioactive.
Fancy purple rounded shape crystal. Upon contact with the artefact, a person's well-being generally improves. Radioactive.
It looks like a Fountain artefact, but has other properties. Slightly restores strength and health. Radioactive.
Anomalous formation consisting of green arcs. Moderately protects against electrical effects and heals wounds. Radioactive.

Thin golden formation of small size, practically weightless. Very valuable artefact, which brings a lot of power to the owner. Stalkers are joking that it is phoenix appeared in the Zone, who drops his feathers. Radioactive.
Well established that radiation from artefact's pulsation causes blood coagulation in open wounds. Also the artefact moderately protects against thermal effects. Radioactive.

A small grayish brown formation similar to a piece of dried meat. Has a hematopoietic effect. Heals the wounds and accelerates blood production. Also moderately protects against chemicals. Radioactive.
A large rainbow substance of irregular shape with numerous tentacles and frequent weak multicolored lights flickering. Valuable artefact, quickly heals wounds.
Rather rare. Can be found only in the northern regions of the Zone. If have it - can almost forget what food is. No negative properties.
Artefact, appearance and origin of which resemble another one - Black Angel. Slightly protects against psi exposures and heals wounds. Radioactive.

Micaceous formation in the form of an uneven circle. Color varies from white to light blue, there are also blue, green and grayish specimens that can be found. By weight and by feel, the bracelet resembles a metal, but it actually consists of the thinnest scales of an unknown material. It is valued for rare beauty and health-beneficial effects. Radioactive.

Green brittle lumps, covered by dark crust when come in contact with air. Moderately protects against psi fields, slightly increases carry weight and gradually restores health of the owner. Radioactive.
Artefact, form and physical properties of which resemble meringue. Slightly increases carry weight, restores strength and heals cuts. Radioactive.
A piece of tightly compressed snowflakes and the smallest parts of the victims of anomaly, shape resembling a heart. It has a positive effect on the body as a whole. Radioactive.
Anomalous formation, somewhat resembling a dirty golden ring. When wearing it heals the owner a bit. A little radioactive.
Rather common emerald viscous substance generated by the Jelly anomaly. When wearing this artefact, wounds are slightly healed. A little radioactive.
Hooplike, sea wave color crystalline substance. Valuable artefact that is good at restoring organism's strength and removing radiation. Radioactive.
Purple stone size and shape of which resembling mushroom. Moderately protects against thermal effects, slightly restores energy reserves. Radioactive.

White, with blue overflowings ring made of light glassy material. Being put on a thin horizontal rod and slightly spun, it continues to move until stopped by the utmost force. The first one "Eternal Engine" found in the Zone. Moderately protects against chemicals, slightly restores energy reserves. Radioactive.

The artefact resembles a blue spider, hence why it got its name. Quickly removes accumulated radiation and because of this it is greatly valued by all on the territory of the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone. Has no negative properties.
It is a milky white color spiral-like substance. Moderately protects against psi exposure and restores energy.
Artefact looks like an octopus with tentacles on the sides. Provides little carry weight increase, restores strength and heals cuts. Radioactive.

Light gray stone, round shape, size of a goose egg. Darker color, as if painted, intricate wavy lines are drawn and points placed on it. Slightly increases maximum carried weight and heals the organism. Radioactive.

string_table.string: . Consists of liquid metal of abnormal origin. It is formed after an Ejection, lasts for a short time, then evaporates.
. Cheap artifacts in the form of metal scraps and construction debris. It has no useful properties. Only of interest to researchers for radiation measurements.
. Cheap artifacts in the form of metal scraps and construction debris. No useful properties. Only of interest to researchers for radiation measurements.

string.text: Unique Artifact. The result of the interaction between Crystal Barb and Meatgrinder. Rarely appears in clusters of anomalies.
Appears in clusters of anomalies. Protects against unconsciousness, restores strength, shields against psi effects.

Born in the anomaly "Trumplin". Such an artifact can be found in few areas of the Zone. Inclusions of metallic compounds give a beautiful play of light. Looking at this artifact in the light of a fire at night is wonderfully soothing.
Formed by the Roast anomaly at high temperatures. Appears as a blackened drop-shaped formation with a glossy surface covered with cracks.

string_table.string: . Superartifact of an electromagnetic nature. A directional field of disintegration. The origin of this item is shrouded in a veil of scientific mystery. It is clear that it includes dielectric elements, but under what physical conditions it is formed - science is unknown. Allows you to carry an additional 4 kg.
. Wearing this artifact denaturalizes proteins more slowly. In other words, the flesh is more resistant to high temperatures and burns less. In itself, it is an expensive and rare item.
. Superartifact of the second level. Appears in clusters of anomalies. Anomalous energy level: very high. Cost: very high. Prevalence: very low.
. This artifact is so rare that many researchers have no idea that such a substance could even exist in the wild. It rejects caustic chemical components.

. Superartifact with unstable gravity. A throwable object is "shot" into a living body after hitting the floor or an obstacle. Once hit, it is "shot" into the next living body until it falls or hits a non-living object. The artifact can then be picked up.
. Big flying fluff, leaves severe burns when it hits the body. It accumulates in lowlands, pits, and hollows. Rises into the air in wind or explosions. It comes out of a buildup of "Stinging Fluff".
. A congenital case of Elektra anomaly activity. Apparently, such a wonderful rounded shape can be obtained by subjecting the anomaly to thermal effects. An expensive artifact.
. Located near anomalies of the Electra type. A fairly common and inexpensive artifact. Nevertheless, it is valued among Zone researchers for its properties.
. Artifact of thermal origin. A transparent shimmering sphere.

string.text: When you hold this enigma of the Zone in your hands, you can feel your skin becoming rough and less sensitive. It is still easy to penetrate it with a bullet, but it is much harder to cut it.

string_table.string: . Generated by the "Funnel" anomaly. An elemental artifact with a directional magnetic-gravity anomaly. Allows you to carry an additional 12 kg.
. Elemental artifact with a directional magnetic-gravity anomaly. Has a variant with more pronounced anomalous properties - "Strong Gravity Artifact". Allows carrying an additional 8 kg.
. Elemental artifact of gravitational nature. Has the shape of a torus, which explains its name. There are at least two known varieties of this artifact, the ordinary and the "Glass Bagel".

string.text: Elemental artifact of organic nature. A bundle of stiff lichen fibers of a dirty rusty color. It has no useful properties.

string_table.string: . A variety of metal junk, which has been lying in gravitational anomalies for a long time, has acquired the ability to create a directed magnetic field of high intensity. This specimen is a fragment of a gear shaft.

string.text: Crystallizes in the "Stinging Fluff" anomaly. It removes radiation from the body naturally. That is, through the ears along with a certain amount of blood. Possible blood loss through other orifices as well. Occurs infrequently and is quite effective, which has earned itself a stable price on the artifact market.
The Stinging Fluff anomaly very rarely generates such an artifact. Increases blood pressure, eliminating large amounts of red blood cells. Temporarily shields against psi effects.

The result of the interaction between the Stinging Fluff anomaly and the body of an inattentive stalker. The spiky artifact prickles the wearer's body, no matter how it is attached. But it also helps cleanse the body of radionuclides. Quite common and cheap.
Very rare near the anomalies "Carousel". Only a few people manage to find such an artifact, and few people have ever seen it. It has a pleasant shape and no less pleasant price.

Located near anomalies of the "Funnel" type. When in contact with the body, it spreads directed radiation that increases stamina. This artifact is not difficult to find, so the money for it is small. It allows you to carry an additional 4 kg.
